generate_multiview_images_for_scene: generate tuples of overlapping views for a given 3D scene with optional depth and camera parameters
run_generate_multiview_images: run the script to generate multiview images for a Habitat-Sim scene with color and depth output
list_scene_commands: list commandlines to generate multiview images for all available scenes using the --list_commands flag
create_commandline: create a commandline string to generate multiview images for a specific scene with configurable depth and exist_ok options
resume_generation: resume interrupted multiview image generation from the last saved metadata.json checkpoint file
